def get_invoice(id_, kind='flight'):
    """拉取单条发票"""
    params = {"booking_id": id_} if kind=='flight' else {"insurance_id": id_}
    resp = requests.get(BASE_URL+"invoice", headers=headers, params=params).json()
    return resp
